asr.transcript: Hi, I was charged twice on my bill.

llm.output_text:
Sorry about that — I can help and will flag this as billing_dispute to get it resolved.

To get started I need a few details (please do not send full card numbers or your SSN):
- Account email or phone number on the account
- Date(s) of the duplicate charge and the exact amounts
- Last 4 digits of the card used
- Any order number or transaction ID(s), or a screenshot of the statement showing the two charges (you can blur all but the merchant name, date, amount, and last 4 digits)

What I’ll do once you provide those:
- Check whether one charge is a pending authorization (these usually drop off in 1–7 days) or two posted charges
- If it’s a posted duplicate, I’ll open an internal dispute and request a refund on your behalf
- I’ll keep you updated on next steps and give an estimated timeline

Estimated timelines:
- Pending authorizations often clear within 1–7 days
- Refunds we issue typically appear on your statement within 3–7 business days, though some banks can take longer
- If we open a formal investigation, it may take up to ~10 business days to complete

If you’d like me to start the investigation now, reply with the details above and confirm you authorize me to check your account. If you prefer phone support, tell me and I’ll give the number and hours.

asr.transcript: It is order RRD 4,481, the August Bill.

llm.output_text:
Thanks — I see this is order RRD 4,481 for the August bill and I can help. To get started, please tell me:

- What’s wrong with the charge (overcharged, duplicate charge, item not ordered, missing discount, late fee, etc.)  
- The exact amount you’re disputing (or what you expected to be billed)  
- How you’d like it resolved (refund to card, account credit, or adjustment)

I’ll also need to verify your identity before I open an investigation — please confirm one of these: last 4 digits of the payment card on file, billing ZIP code, or the email on the account. Once I have that info I’ll open a billing_dispute and aim to complete the review within 5–7 business days. If you prefer, I can escalate you to a billing specialist now. Which would you like to do?
